sloka: तच्च सर्वं मया क्षान्तं रावणस्य कुलक्षयम् ।अवज्ञां पुरतः कृत्वा मया यूयं विशेषतः ।। ७.६८.१५ ॥
transliteration: tacca sarvaṁ mayā kṣāntaṁ rāvaṇasya kulakṣayam ।avajñāṁ purataḥ kṛtvā mayā yūyaṁ viśeṣataḥ ।। 7.68.15 ॥

translations.english: I tolerated all that, the destruction of Ravana's lineage, but I have especially shown contempt towards you all from the very beginning.
